description: This file defines a utility class for escaping and sanitizing log parameters to prevent issues with special characters in logs, such as newlines and tabs.

classes.name: LogParameterEscapeUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to escape special characters in log parameters.

methods.name: escapeLogParameter
methods.description: Replaces newline, carriage return, and tab characters in the input string with underscores.

methods.name: escapeLogMDCParameter
methods.description: Removes carriage return and newline characters from the input string.
